checks: Independent migrated database and ordinary/admin/board-moderator identities
All new upload purposes work; staged uploads are readable only by their owner
Real image/PDF parsing, MIME-extension matching, active PDF rejection, path and size limits
Posts persist in two boards; attachments bind atomically and valid PDFs download with safe headers
Unicode text boundaries, disabled boards, forged fields and null/no-op edits are rejected
CSRF, exact Origin and author restrictions protect forum writes for every role
Likes and favorites are idempotent; personal collections return only current public posts
Comments preserve same-post parent relationships, counts and latest reply metadata
Concurrent edits with the same version preserve one successful update and reject the stale write
Failed publishing rolls back posts and bindings; ownership, purpose, duplication and attachment counts are enforced
Replacing/removing bound files revokes old URLs immediately and physical cleanup returns quota
Only authorized moderators can manage their board; pinned posts lead stable public ordering
Hidden posts leave public views; file reads enforce author/board governance scope and restore correctly
Hidden/deleted comments use safe placeholders, retain reply structure and cannot restore deleted text
Public/personal/admin responses conform to 4.3 OpenAPI with bounded stable pagination
Shared quota and staged expiry/cleanup apply to goods uploads as well as forum attachments
Three real browser cases: forum/upload/edit flow, moderator scope and actual database-failure form recovery
Actual database outage returns failure; restarted API/MySQL/Redis preserve forum records and sessions
Soft deletion revokes content/files; durable content-change jobs and moderation audit are recorded together
